business_problem: Alex Nagle, Customer Services Director, VIVID Coming out of the pandemic, VIVID knew it needed to upgrade its legacy systems to modern cloud-based solutions.
solution_summary: VIVID built its Microsoft solution to improve customer-service and conversational-support workflows. Alex Nagle, Customer Services Director, VIVID Coming out of the pandemic, VIVID knew it needed to upgrade its legacy systems to modern cloud-based solutions. Key components included Microsoft Copilot Studio coordinated workflows, prompts, or deployment, and Dynamics 365 Customer Service delivered dashboards, apps, or copilots to users. Requests and business records enter Dynamics 365 Customer Service, where Microsoft Copilot Studio assists routing, summaries, or responses before the updated information is surfaced back to employees and customers through the Microsoft application layer. The stack stayed governed and extensible on Microsoft. They enhanced their contact centre with the Microsoft Digital Contact Centre platform, integrating skill-based routing, IVR, chatbots, and Copilot.

solution_components.role: Provides the managed environment to design, test, and operate custom copilots.

solution_components.name: Dynamics 365 Customer Service
solution_components.role: Provides the case-management and service workspace for customer-support teams.

solution_components.name: Microsoft Power Platform
solution_components.role: Supports low-code automation and app development around Microsoft business data.

solution_components.name: Azure
solution_components.role: Provides the core cloud infrastructure and managed services underlying the deployment.
